wire.t: Rome Alone has three empty starting spots in its Week 10 lineup on Sleeper this morning: quarterback, flex and defense. Marco_Polo picked up Bryce Young and the Rams defense on waivers Wednesday and both are sitting on the bench, along with Corey Kiner ($23) and Audric Estime ($15). Kickoff for those games is Sunday.

Week 10 starts tonight with Washington at the Giants (8:15 PM ET, Prime Video). Jayden Daniels practiced fully all week and has no game designation, and Cam Skattebo is back from the hamstring with no designation. Seven league starters play tonight: Daniels and Malik Nabers (I Pulled My McCaff), Antonio Williams and Isaiah Likely (LetLamarCook), Stefon Diggs (McCallyCockin(his butt)), Rachaad White (MarcusbetterLockNjigba) and Skattebo (Skatabooboo).

Lions WR Amon-Ra St. Brown was limited at Wednesday's practice with a rib injury, the same as all last week before he played in Miami. He is listed questionable on Sleeper and is in the McCallyCockin(his butt) starting lineup. Friday's report decides whether he carries a designation for Sunday against New England.

Free-agent moves after the waiver run: Bill_Buttlicker added the Pittsburgh defense and dropped Demarcus Robinson, with the Tampa Bay defense on bye. YourMomsDildo swapped the Detroit defense for Buffalo. tballsmccall added Xavier Legette, who is on IR, and dropped Josh Cameron.

Patrick Mahomes no longer carries an injury designation on Sleeper after the elbow sprain, and Footballguys expected him to play in Week 10. Josh Jacobs is out after finger surgery (up to three weeks) and Rhamondre Stevenson is out with a plantaris issue that could mean IR.

Rams WR Puka Nacua is on injured reserve with MCL and PCL sprains and turf toe. PickensMyPukaHurts! still has an empty receiver spot in its Week 10 lineup with George Pickens questionable on the bench.
Ravens QB Lamar Jackson is on IR after thumb surgery, with Week 14 as the earliest return. LetLamarCook is 7‑2 and goes with Patrick Mahomes.

Byes in Week 10: Bears, Broncos, Eagles and Buccaneers. Rome Alone has Caleb Williams, Rome Odunze, Colston Loveland and Bucky Irving off, and MarcusbetterLockNjigba has Bo Nix off with Sam Darnold out and Drew Lock questionable on Sleeper.

stories.title: Rome Alone has three empty starting spots, and Marco_Polo's waiver pickups are on the bench
stories.dek: No quarterback, no flex, no defense. Bryce Young and the Rams defense are right there. Week 10 starts tonight with Washington at the Giants.
body: Marco_Polo spent Wednesday morning buying bye-week cover: Corey Kiner for $23, Audric Estime for $15, Bryce Young for $5 and the Rams defense for $5. As of this morning, all four are on the Rome Alone bench and the starting lineup has nothing at quarterback, nothing at flex and nothing at defense. Six names, three holes. Rome Alone is 6‑3 and a 4.0-point favorite over MarcusbetterLockNjigba, and our line assumes somebody clicks the buttons before Sunday.

To be fair to Marco_Polo, none of those players go until Sunday, so there's time. To be fair to me, I run this website and I am going to screenshot it every morning until it's fixed. PickensMyPukaHurts! still has its own empty receiver spot where Puka Nacua was, so ChuckJ10 is in the same club.

Tonight is Washington at the Giants. Jayden Daniels practiced fully all week and has no designation, and Cam Skattebo is back with no designation. Seven league starters play: Daniels and Malik Nabers for I Pulled My McCaff, Antonio Williams and Isaiah Likely for LetLamarCook, Stefon Diggs for McCallyCockin(his butt), Rachaad White for MarcusbetterLockNjigba and Skattebo for Skatabooboo.

Meanwhile Bill_Buttlicker grabbed the Pittsburgh defense to replace Tampa Bay on the bye and has Amon-Ra St. Brown listed questionable with a rib injury (limited Wednesday). That trims my own line to 3.5 over PickensMyPukaHurts!. I'm still favored. I'd like that noted.

columns.title: ClaytonBigsbi, you don't cut a running back to start Tutu Atwell
columns.dek: Alvin Kamara: 73.7 points in seven games. Tutu Atwell: 16.9 in five. You're 0‑9.
body: ClaytonBigsbi dropped Alvin Kamara this morning. Kamara has 73.7 PPR points in seven games. He had 22.8 in Week 4 and 14.9 and 13.2 in Weeks 6 and 7. The guy who came in is Tutu Atwell, who has 16.9 points in five games, and Atwell is in the starting lineup on Sunday.
I've seen guys take a play off. I've never seen a guy take a whole roster spot off. You're 0‑9 with a 7‑92 all-play and the move was to get lighter.
The defense swap was right. Chicago is on bye, Baltimore isn't. One for two. Now go get Kamara back before somebody with a pulse does.

columns.title: Oliver Klozoff's Thursday night checklist (do all of these before 8:15)
columns.dek: Seven league starters play tonight in Washington at the Giants. I have prepared.
body: 1. Marco_Polo, leave the Rome Alone quarterback spot empty. Nobody can throw an interception from an empty spot. Same with defense. You can't give up points if you aren't there. This is called defense.

2. Hing1eMcCring13berry, you have Jayden Daniels and Malik Nabers tonight. Bench them both so you have something to look forward to on Sunday. Jordan Love on the bench scored 36.18 last week, so the bench is clearly where the points are.
3. DuvalTiliFall, you have Antonio Williams and Isaiah Likely tonight. Start them twice. If Sleeper says no, that's Sleeper's opinion.
4. ClaytonBigsbi, Cam Skattebo is back tonight. Trade him before he scores so you sell high on zero. That's a 100 percent return on nothing.
5. Bill_Buttlicker, you added the Pittsburgh defense. Start the Tampa Bay defense too, on bye, as a decoy. Defenses love a decoy.

columns.title: Marco_Polo paid $23 for Corey Kiner, which my model says is $0.72 a point
columns.dek: Kiner has 32.0 points this season. Marvin Harrison Jr. has 37.5. I have adjusted for vibes.
body: Corey Kiner has 32.0 PPR points this season, so the $23 bid works out to $0.72 per point already scored. Marvin Harrison Jr., the player dropped to make room, has 37.5 points, which is 5.5 more. By my math Marco_Polo paid $23 to have 5.5 fewer points, which is $4.18 per point lost. I have colored this cell green because green is a good color.
Kiner had 11.5 of his 32.0 in Week 9. That is 35.9 percent of his season in one week. If the trend continues he will have 100 percent of his season by Week 12, which my model calls a breakout.

Rome Alone also bought Bryce Young for $5 and the Rams defense for $5. Total spend Wednesday: $48. Rome Alone is a 4.0-point favorite over MarcusbetterLockNjigba, so that is $12 per point of spread. I can't say if that's good. I can say the spreadsheet is very pretty.

facts: Shootyeah won in 2024 after tying for the best record at 10-4. YourMomsDildo won in 2025 from 9-5.
ChuckJ10 and GeorigaGoocher both went 11-3 in 2025. Neither made the final.
ClaytonBigsbi's 54.70 in 2026 Week 7 is the lowest score in league history, 5.74 below DuvalTiliFall's 60.44 in 2025 Week 11.

Marco_Polo's Rome Alone beat ClaytonBigsbi's Skatabooboo 176.52 to 54.70 in 2026 Week 7. The 121.82-point margin is the biggest in league history, 14.66 more than the old record (107.16, Week 2 this year).
RedDevil904's 192.90 in Week 5 this year is the highest score in league history. His 186.82 in Week 2 is third.
ClaytonBigsbi has had the lowest score of the week four times in nine weeks in 2026: Weeks 4, 6, 7 and 8. Shootyeah has three, in Weeks 1, 2 and 9.
